aupro_check.note: Cross-check between two independent implementations in this notebook. Not a third-party validation.

reproduction_check.explanation: The two AUPRO values differ by ~0.0012 because Experiment 6 scored the test set in batches on the fly, while Experiment 8 pre-loads the entire test set to GPU memory to stabilise timing. The intermediate interpolation path and tensor shapes differ slightly, which shifts the anomaly map values and hence the AUPRO integral by a small amount. The current `auro` also includes the single-FPR-case handling added during the AUPRO bug fix. The difference is well within the reproduction tolerance of 0.005, so the reference run is considered consistent within tolerance rather than numerically identical across experiments.
